fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 overclaims: each nonzero quotient class having some separating functional does not imply one functional simultaneously detects all classes over the finite field, much less one factoring as a_jb_k. Its quotient also must encode every honest equation, not merely selected reassociations.

Proposal 2 is the only frontier-relevant survivor, but its proposed 111-only first stage is inadequate. A residue-field point alone also does not establish an exact lift satisfying the honest equations modulo P^2.

Proposal 3 fails Q1 as stated: blocks placed at positive powers of Pi have zero degree-zero initial symbol, and a two-block audit omits the complete Graver universe. Earliest-block stability is additionally unproved under carries and transport.

Proposal 4 merely relabels each pair (j,k) by its uniquely determined product r. Once the r-marginal is included in the grading, every move in the recomputed same-fiber Markov basis automatically has zero r-moment, so the proposed test is tautological rather than a soundness audit.

Proposal 5's bounded valuation MILP is only a necessary tropical screen. It ignores coefficient valuations and units, and a feasible exponent assignment does not solve the exact honest product equations or produce a liftable transfer map.

Proposal 6 has no fixed transfer map or serialized COPY tile to optimize, so it is premature; the prior augmented-Gram family already failed DROP. Proposal 7 certifies at most a Markov/Groebner generating set, which neither enumerates the Graver basis nor prevents cancellation among generated moves; its 2x2 toy is not the actual frontier seam.
evidence: The supplied verifiers certify false 010, 100, and 111 grade-zero fibers at energies 64, 56, and 56, and every one of 378 tested affine COPY codes admits the false111-COPY11-false111 splice in both orientations.
The N=8 redundant NAND module is only a depth-one survivor with legal energy 8 and false energies 160, 64, 56, 56. No product-tagged COPY module or complete Q1 tile has verifier evidence.

ROADMAP identifies Q1's crux as simultaneous separation of the complete projected-fiber Graver basis by genuine product tags, including DROP and the observed 111 exchange. Proposal 2 directly tests that finite algebraic condition if strengthened to one complete certified run.

The compiled Lean result proves only conditional telescoping after local transitions and potentials are supplied. It provides no evidence for lift independence, carry stability, Q2, or recursive amplification.

Prior finite passes repeatedly failed under composition, including G28, G32, and G37. Therefore even a successful product specialization would be finite Q1 evidence only, not an asymptotic gap theorem.
next_experiment: Run a repaired Proposal 2 once: hash-lock the N=8 NAND survivor and one deterministically selected saturated COPY seam; export every emitted equation and both COPY orientations; compute the complete integer projected-fiber Graver basis with independently checkable completeness and primitive certificates; then solve exactly over O/P^2 for product parameters a_j,b_k satisfying all honest equations while requiring nonzero mod-P initial tags for every non-honest primitive, every false boundary, DROP, and internal zero-boundary kernel. Return either one fully checkable specialization and lift or the first unavoidable zero; a pass authorizes only further Q1/Q2 testing, not Q1 as a whole or any asymptotic claim.
